project: Wuxia Life P6B PostgreSQL Save Persistence and Session API
description: Build the first deployable backend foundation for Wuxia Life with a lightweight TypeScript Node HTTP service backed by self-hosted PostgreSQL, making the backend authoritative for anonymous device identity, sessions, three save slots, immutable snapshots, append-only replay actions, versioned event catalog reads, and trusted choice execution while switching the existing Web client to the API-backed save and resume loop without expanding into accounts, mini-program work, gameplay rebalance, or visual redesign.

userStories.title: Rebaseline P6B Integration Boundaries
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only inventory of the current P5 headless, Web runtime, snapshot, catalog, and save boundaries so that backend work starts from the proven path.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory current P5 headless session construction and dependency injection points
Inventory current Web new-game, continue-game, choice, save, and load entry points
Inventory snapshot conversion, replay, catalog, and version validation helpers
Identify service-path blockers caused by Vue reactivity, global singletons, browser storage, or direct console logging
Produce a P6B integration-baseline report
Do not modify business code
